extraction_metadata.notes: Purely quantum-inspired classical probability modeling. Quantum State Model (QSM) assigns |0>/|1> = up/down daily return, estimating single-asset directional probabilities; Entangled Asset Model (EAM) extends to two-asset joint distribution with 'entanglement' = empirical correlation of daily up/down signs. No circuit, no simulator, no QPU. Implemented in Python with numpy/pandas/yfinance.

paper_metadata.title: Integrating Quantum-Inspired Principles into Financial Data Science: Optimizing Reservoir Computing Models
paper_metadata.venue: International Journal of Scientific Research in Engineering and Management (IJSREM)

summary: Quantum-inspired reservoir-computing-style probability model for equity returns. Defines a Quantum State Model (QSM) mapping each daily return sign to |0>=down or |1>=up with empirical Born-rule probabilities, and an Entangled Asset Model (EAM) mapping joint up/down signs of two assets to a 2-qubit classical probability vector with 'entanglement' quantified via Pearson correlation of sign sequences. Applied to AAPL and MSFT daily adjusted-close returns from Yahoo Finance over 2000-01-01 to 2024-01-01. Purely classical implementation; no quantum circuit, simulator, or QPU is used.

experiments.description: Quantum State Model (QSM): single-asset directional probability estimation. For each asset, daily adjusted-close returns over 2000-01-01 to 2024-01-01 (Yahoo Finance, ~24 years of daily data) are classified up vs down and empirical P(up)/P(down) are reported for AAPL and MSFT.

algorithm.variant: Quantum State Model (QSM): basis-state encoding |0>=down, |1>=up with amplitudes set to empirical sign frequencies

hyperparameters.return_definition: daily log/simple return of adjusted close

problem_formulation.encoding_details: One qubit per asset; basis states |0>/|1> represent down/up daily returns. Probabilities are empirical frequencies, not produced by any quantum circuit.

problem_instance.dataset_name: Yahoo Finance AAPL and MSFT daily adjusted close (2000-2024)

dataset_specification.description: Daily adjusted-close prices for AAPL and MSFT from Yahoo Finance via yfinance, converted to daily returns. ~24 years of daily observations per asset.

speedup_claims.notes: No speedup claimed; descriptive probability model.

complexity_analysis.classical_complexity: O(N) over N daily observations to compute empirical sign frequencies.

notes: QSM probabilities read directly from paper text/Table. No quantum hardware or simulator used; 'qubit' is a conceptual 2-state label for up/down return sign.

experiments.description: Entangled Asset Model (EAM): two-asset joint directional probability estimation for (AAPL, MSFT). Joint up/down signs are enumerated over 2000-01-01 to 2024-01-01 and mapped to 2-qubit basis states |00>,|01>,|10>,|11> with empirical joint probabilities; 'entanglement' quantified by Pearson correlation of sign sequences.

algorithm.variant: Entangled Asset Model (EAM): 2-qubit basis-state joint probability vector with correlation-based 'entanglement' proxy
algorithm.ansatz: |psi>=sum_{ij} c_{ij}|ij>, |c_{ij}|^2 = empirical joint frequency of (sign_AAPL, sign_MSFT)

hyperparameters.entanglement_proxy: Pearson correlation of daily sign sequences

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Two qubits, one per asset (AAPL, MSFT). |0>/|1> = down/up daily return. Joint amplitudes set to empirical joint frequencies.

problem_instance.dataset_name: Yahoo Finance AAPL+MSFT joint daily returns (2000-2024)

dataset_specification.description: Daily adjusted-close returns for AAPL and MSFT from Yahoo Finance; paired by trading date to form joint sign sequence.

results.notes: Pearson correlation of AAPL and MSFT daily sign sequences, used as 'entanglement' proxy.

complexity_analysis.classical_complexity: O(N) to tabulate joint empirical frequencies over N aligned daily observations.

notes: EAM joint probabilities and correlation read directly from paper text. 'Entanglement' here is operationalized as classical Pearson correlation; no genuine quantum entanglement is generated.
